courseName: AAI Junior Executive (Common Cadre) Mock Test

questions.question: Blood Relations: His father is the only son of my father-in-law. How are they related?
questions.hint: Only son of father-in-law is husband. Husband's son is her son.

questions.question: Blood Relations: She is the daughter of the only son of my grandfather. How are they related?
questions.hint: Only son of grandfather is father. Father's daughter is sister.

questions.question: Blood Relations: A + B means A is father of B; A - B means A is sister of B; A * B means A is son of B. What does P + Q - R * S imply?. How are they related?
questions.hint: P is father of Q & R, S is mother of R => P & S married.

questions.question: Blood Relations: Pointing to a man, a woman said: 'His mother is the only daughter of my mother.'. How are they related?
questions.hint: Only daughter of mother is self. She is his mother.

questions.question: Blood Relations: X is brother of Y. Y is wife of Z. Z is son of W. How is X related to Z?. How are they related?
questions.hint: X is wife's brother => Brother-in-law.

questions.question: Blood Relations: If P is father of Q, R is son of S, T is brother of P, and Q is sister of R, how is S related to T?. How are they related?
questions.hint: S is mother of Q & R (P's wife). T is P's brother => Sister-in-law.

questions.question: Blood Relations: Introducing a boy, a girl said, 'He is the son of the daughter of the father of my uncle.'. How are they related?
questions.hint: Father of uncle is grandfather. Grandfather's daughter is aunt/mother. Her son is cousin.

questions.question: Blood Relations: A's mother is sister of B and daughter of C. D is daughter of B and sister of E. How is C related to E?. How are they related?
questions.hint: C is parent of B, B is parent of E => C is grandparent.

questions.question: Blood Relations: Showing a picture of an old man, Amit said, 'His son is my son's uncle.' How is the old man related to Amit?. How are they related?
questions.hint: Amit's son's uncle is Amit's brother. Old man is his father.

questions.question: Blood Relations: M is sister of N. N is father of O. P is wife of M. How is O related to M?. How are they related?
questions.hint: M is aunt of O.

questions.question: Blood Relations: A is father of B, but B is not his son. How is B related to A?. How are they related?
questions.hint: B is A's daughter.

questions.question: Blood Relations: Pointing to a photograph, Rakesh said, 'She is the mother of my son's wife.' How is Rakesh related to the woman?. How are they related?
questions.hint: Son's wife is daughter-in-law. Her mother is co-in-law.

questions.question: Blood Relations: If A is B's sister, C is B's mother, D is C's father, E is D's mother, how is A related to D?. How are they related?
questions.hint: D is C's father, C is A's mother => A is granddaughter.

questions.question: Blood Relations: B is the brother of A, whose mother is C. D is the father of C. How is B related to D?. How are they related?
questions.hint: C is mother of B, D is father of C => B is grandson.

questions.question: Blood Relations: E is brother of B, A is sister of B. How is A related to E?. How are they related?
questions.hint: A and E are siblings.

questions.question: Blood Relations: K is brother of T. T is wife of M. M is son of R. How is K related to R?. How are they related?
questions.hint: K is brother of R's daughter-in-law.

questions.question: Blood Relations: P is brother of Q. R is mother of Q. S is father of R. T is mother of S. How is P related to S?. How are they related?
questions.hint: R is mother of P, S is father of R => P is grandson.

questions.question: Blood Relations: A and B are married couple. X and Y are brothers. X is brother of A. How is Y related to B?. How are they related?
questions.hint: Y is A's brother => B's brother-in-law.

questions.question: Blood Relations: Rahul told Anand, 'Yesterday I defeated the only brother of the daughter of my grandmother.' Who did Rahul defeat?. How are they related?
questions.hint: Daughter of grandmother is aunt. Her only brother is father.

questions.question: Blood Relations: Deepak has a brother Anil. Deepak is the son of Prem. Vimal is Prem's father. In terms of relationship, how is Anil related to Vimal?. How are they related?
questions.hint: Prem is father of Anil, Vimal is father of Prem => Anil is grandson.

questions.question: Blood Relations: If 'A $ B' means A is father of B, 'A # B' means A is mother of B, what does P $ Q # R mean?. How are they related?
options: P is maternal grandfather of R
questions.hint: P is father of Q, Q is mother of R => P is maternal grandfather.

questions.question: Blood Relations: Looking at a portrait, a man said, 'I have no brother or sister, but that man's father is my father's son.' Whose portrait is it?. How are they related?
questions.hint: Father's son is himself. 'That man's father is me' => His son.

questions.question: Blood Relations: A is B's brother. C is A's mother. D is C's father. F is A's son. How is F related to D?. How are they related?
questions.hint: D is grandfather of A. F is son of A => Great-grandson.

questions.question: Blood Relations: M is father of N, L is brother of M, P is mother of L. How is N related to P?. How are they related?
questions.hint: P is mother of M, N is child of M => Grandchild.

questions.question: Blood Relations: Q is mother of P. P is wife of R. S is brother of R. How is S related to Q?. How are they related?
questions.hint: P is Q's daughter. R is P's husband. S is R's brother.

questions.question: Which Constitutional Amendment Act added the terms 'Socialist', 'Secular', and 'Integrity' to the Preamble of the Indian Constitution?
questions.hint: The 42nd Amendment Act (1976) added Socialist, Secular, and Integrity to the Preamble.

questions.question: Kaziranga National Park, a UNESCO World Heritage Site famous for preserving two-thirds of the world's great one-horned rhinoceroses, is located in which Indian state?
questions.hint: Kaziranga National Park is located in Assam.

questions.question: Under which Article of the Indian Constitution is the Finance Commission constituted by the President every five years to allocate tax revenues between the Union and States?
questions.hint: Article 280 provides for the constitution of the Finance Commission.

questions.question: Who presided over the 1929 Lahore Session of the Indian National Congress where the historic resolution for 'Purna Swaraj' (Complete Independence) was adopted?
questions.hint: Jawaharlal Nehru presided over the 1929 Lahore INC session.

questions.question: What is the minimum age requirement prescribed by the Indian Constitution for election as the President of India?
questions.hint: Minimum age for election as President of India is 35 Years.

questions.question: Which Schedule of the Indian Constitution specifies the 22 officially recognized languages of India?
questions.hint: Eighth Schedule lists the 22 recognized languages of India.

questions.question: Which prominent Indus Valley Civilization site located in Gujarat is famous for possessing the world's earliest known artificial brick dockyard?
questions.hint: Lothal in Gujarat featured an ancient tidal dockyard.

questions.question: Which Fundamental Rights guaranteed by the Indian Constitution cannot be suspended even during a National Emergency declared under Article 352?
questions.hint: Articles 20 and 21 cannot be suspended during National Emergency.

questions.question: Which is the highest mountain peak situated entirely within the territorial boundaries of India?
questions.hint: Kangchenjunga (8,586 m) is the highest peak entirely within Indian territory.

questions.question: Who founded the Arya Samaj in 1875 and gave the famous slogan 'Back to the Vedas'?
questions.hint: Swami Dayanand Saraswati founded Arya Samaj with the slogan 'Back to the Vedas'.

questions.question: Through how many Indian states does the Tropic of Cancer pass?
questions.hint: The Tropic of Cancer passes through 8 Indian States.

questions.question: In the historical Battle of Plassey (1757), Robert Clive defeated which Nawab of Bengal to lay the foundation of British rule in India?
questions.hint: Robert Clive defeated Siraj-ud-Daulah in the Battle of Plassey (1757).

questions.question: Who serves as the ex-officio Chairman of the Rajya Sabha (Council of States) in the Indian Parliament?
questions.hint: The Vice-President of India is the ex-officio Chairman of Rajya Sabha.

questions.question: Which type of soil, formed from basalt lava and known for high moisture retention, is most suitable for cotton cultivation in India?
questions.hint: Black Regur Soil is ideal for moisture retention and cotton crops.

questions.question: Following the 104th Constitutional Amendment Act which abolished nominated Anglo-Indian seats, what is the maximum sanctioned strength of the Lok Sabha?
questions.hint: Maximum sanctioned strength of Lok Sabha after 104th Amendment is 550 Members.

questions.question: Which Article of the Indian Constitution grants the Right to Constitutional Remedies, referred to by Dr. B.R. Ambedkar as the 'Heart and Soul' of the Constitution?
questions.hint: Article 32 guarantees the Right to Constitutional Remedies.

questions.question: Which Viceroy of India was responsible for the Partition of Bengal in 1905, triggering the Swadeshi Movement?
questions.hint: Lord Curzon partitioned Bengal in 1905.

questions.question: Which river is known as 'Dakshin Ganga' and is the longest peninsular river in India?
questions.hint: Godavari River is the longest peninsular river in India, often called Dakshin Ganga.

questions.question: Who serves as the ex-officio Chairman of the 6-member Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) in India?
options: Governor of Reserve Bank of India
questions.hint: The RBI Governor is the ex-officio Chairman of the Monetary Policy Committee.

questions.question: Which Constitutional Amendment Act introduced the Goods and Services Tax (GST) across India?
questions.hint: The 101st Amendment Act, 2016 introduced Goods and Services Tax (GST).

questions.question: Which Constitutional Amendment Act added the terms 'Socialist', 'Secular', and 'Integrity' to the Preamble of the Indian Constitution?
questions.hint: The 42nd Amendment Act (1976) added Socialist, Secular, and Integrity to the Preamble.

questions.question: Kaziranga National Park, a UNESCO World Heritage Site famous for preserving two-thirds of the world's great one-horned rhinoceroses, is located in which Indian state?
questions.hint: Kaziranga National Park is located in Assam.

questions.question: Under which Article of the Indian Constitution is the Finance Commission constituted by the President every five years to allocate tax revenues between the Union and States?
questions.hint: Article 280 provides for the constitution of the Finance Commission.

questions.question: Who presided over the 1929 Lahore Session of the Indian National Congress where the historic resolution for 'Purna Swaraj' (Complete Independence) was adopted?
questions.hint: Jawaharlal Nehru presided over the 1929 Lahore INC session.

questions.question: What is the minimum age requirement prescribed by the Indian Constitution for election as the President of India?
questions.hint: Minimum age for election as President of India is 35 Years.

questions.hint: Opposite meaning: Antonym of taciturn (reserved/untalkative) is garrulous.

questions.hint: Gregarious means fond of company; sociable.

questions.hint: Opposite meaning: Equanimity means mental calmness and composure in difficult situations.

questions.hint: Antonym of impervious (unable to be affected) is penetrable.

questions.question: English Vocabulary #40: Select the direct ANTONYM of the given word: 'ESOTERIC'
questions.hint: Opposite meaning: Esoteric means intended for or understood by only a small group.

questions.question: English Vocabulary #41: Select the most appropriate SYNONYM of the word: 'METICULOUS'
questions.hint: Meticulous means paying extreme attention to detail; precise.

questions.question: English Vocabulary #42: Select the direct ANTONYM of the given word: 'EPHEMERAL'
questions.hint: Opposite meaning: Antonym of ephemeral (short-lived) is permanent/eternal.

questions.hint: Antonym of obsequious (excessively submissive) is assertive.

questions.hint: Opposite meaning: Candid means honest, direct, and truthful.
